steps.code:
# We need to keep going to next song until we reach a downloaded song.
# Downloaded song IDs: 55, 66, 13, 8, 301
downloaded_ids = {55, 66, 13, 8, 301}

# Loop until we find a downloaded song
for _ in range(1000):
    # Go to next song
    next_result = apis.spotify.next_song(access_token=access_token)
    print("Next song result:", next_result)
    
    # Get current song
    current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
    print("Current song:", current)
    
    # Check if current song is downloaded
    if current["song_id"] in downloaded_ids:
        print("Found downloaded song:", current["title"])
        break
else:
    print("Did not find a downloaded song within 1000 iterations")
